_provenance.source: Operator-reported failure text from the East End Dubs Newcastle signup launch (task #115) — not a byte-for-byte capture we took ourselves, unlike the 1713140 fixture. The message text below is quoted verbatim from the operator's report.
_provenance.ad_set: Similar Pages — page_group with a 10-page seed and 40+ engagement custom audiences. Meta builds ad-set targeting atomically, so one stale custom audience among the 40+ rejects the whole ad set.
_provenance.note: Unlike the 1713140 refusal, this message does NOT name the offending audience id(s) verbatim — the recovery ladder falls back to a batch delivery_status/operation_status check (see fetchCustomAudienceAvailability in lib/meta/client.ts) rather than parsing an id out of the text.

error.message: This ad set is using one or more custom audiences, which are no longer available. You'll need to remove these unavailable audiences to publish this ad set.
